name: Val Hoyle

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Hoyle lists her occupation as U.S. congresswoman.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Lane County edition)

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists prior service as Oregon commissioner and state representative, and chair of the Federal Export Council of Oregon.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Lane County edition)

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Lane County edition)

bio.statement: Her official House biography says she was sworn into the 118th Congress in January 2023 representing Oregon's Fourth District.

bio.statement: Her official biography says she was elected to the Oregon House in 2010, representing West Eugene and Junction City.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle

positions.statement: Hoyle's pamphlet statement says she is working to expand Social Security and Medicare and protect them from cuts.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Lane County edition)

voting_record.statement: Hoyle voted No on the House motion to concur in the Senate amendment to H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, on July 3, 2025 (Roll Call 190, 218-214).
voting_record.excerpt: QUESTION: On Motion to Concur in the Senate Amendment … BILL TITLE: One Big Beautiful Bill Act … ---- NOES 214 --- … Hoyle (OR)

voting_record.statement: Hoyle voted Nay on House passage of S. 5, the Laken Riley Act, on January 22, 2025 (Roll Call 23, 263-156).

collection_notes: Steps 4-6 (open-web and T3 press searches) could not be completed for every candidate because the WebSearch budget shared by all agents in this run ran out (searches marked 'blocked' in collection_log were not run); searches that did run produced no items that were used.
